sections.title: Sound of P
paragraphs: The letter name is (P) /piː/. It usually makes the sound /p/, as in the word (pen) /pɛn/, which means pen. This letter has two sounds across English words.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: Close both lips together firmly to stop the breath completely. Let air build up behind them, then open your lips quickly with a small burst of air. Keep your vocal cords still so your throat does not vibrate. Hold your hand before your mouth to feel the quick puff of air.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: In most words, this letter makes the sound /p/ at the beginning, middle, or end, as in (cup) /kʌp/. In some words, this letter is silent and makes no sound at all, as in (cupboard) /kʌ.bəd/ and (corps) /kɔː/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not voice this consonant like the sound in bad. Keep your throat quiet so it does not sound like a different letter. At the start of words, do not forget the small burst of air.
